def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Find the solid 2x2 block of a non-background color.
    for r in range(len(grid)-1):
        for c in range(len(grid[0])-1):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color != 7 and all(grid[y][x] == color for y in (r,r+1) for x in (c,c+1)):
                out[r-1][c] = out[r-1][c+1] = 2
                out[r+2][c] = out[r+2][c+1] = 2
                out[r][c-1] = out[r+1][c-1] = 2
                out[r][c+2] = out[r+1][c+2] = 2
                return out
    return out
